stem_book: If pr = 2(q + s) (p, q, r, s real), then among the equations x² + px + q = 0 and x² + rx + s = 0 (a) both have real roots (b) both have imaginary roots (c) at least one has real roots (d) at least one has imaginary roots
key: c at least one has real roots
derived: c at least one has real roots
correct_answer: c at least one has real roots
reason: Corrected print misprint in option (b) 'both hence imaginary roots' to 'both have imaginary roots'; added p, q, r, s real.
work: D₁ + D₂ = p² + r² − 4(q + s) = p² + r² − 2pr = (p − r)² ≥ 0 ⇒ at least one D ≥ 0
